input.body: We are writing to ask for a review of a $15.00 deduction on order UE-tf03c, dated 2026-11-05, which was deducted with the reason "missing item" (Garlic Naan). Our records show the order was ready at 20:33 and was picked up by the courier at 20:36, 3 minutes later [UE-tf03c:pickup_handoff]. This indicates the order was handed off promptly after it was prepared. We recognise that our records do not show the contents of the bag at handoff, so we are stating only what the timestamps show. Based on this, we respectfully request that the deduction be reviewed and, if possible, reversed. We are happy to provide any further information that would help.
